tasks.label: [layered] dart format
args: set -euo pipefail; pkgs=(packages/annotations packages/lint example/app example/foundation/dependency_injection example/domain/todo example/data/repository/todo example/data/repository/todo/_impl example/data/injection example/usecase/todo example/usecase/todo/_impl example/usecase/injection example/screen/feature/todo_list); for d in "${pkgs[@]}"; do [ -d "$d/lib" ] && dart format "$d/lib"; [ -d "$d/test" ] && dart format "$d/test"; done

tasks.label: [layered] dart analyze
args: set -euo pipefail; dart analyze --fatal-infos --fatal-warnings; dart analyze --fatal-infos --fatal-warnings packages/lint

tasks.label: [layered] dart test
args: set -euo pipefail; pkgs=(packages/annotations example/domain/todo example/data/repository/todo example/data/repository/todo/_impl example/usecase/todo example/usecase/todo/_impl); for d in "${pkgs[@]}"; do if compgen -G "$d/test/*_test.dart" > /dev/null; then (cd "$d" && dart test ./test/); fi; done

tasks.label: [layered] flutter test
args: set -euo pipefail; pkgs=(example/app example/foundation/dependency_injection example/data/injection example/usecase/injection example/screen/feature/todo_list); for d in "${pkgs[@]}"; do if compgen -G "$d/test/*_test.dart" > /dev/null; then (cd "$d" && flutter test ./test/); fi; done
